prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A small hooded skeletal reaper swings a scythe at the glowing silver cord tethering a sleeping man's soul to his body. The cord bows like a drawn bowstring, holds, and throws the scythe out of her hands past her own head. Pixar-style 3D animated feature, supernatural horror played with total solemn conviction and precise comic timing.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
<<<image_1>>> REAPER: 1.50 m hooded robed skeletal figure, bone hands, glowing red eyes, dark red-brown hood and robe. Both hands gripping the scythe haft. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_2>>> SPIRIT FATHER: translucent glowing soul of FATHER, 1.90 m, same face, hair and build as FATHER, warm luminous edge, semi-transparent body. 100% matches the reference.
<<<image_3>>> SILVER CORD: single continuous luminous silver-white strand, smooth, unbroken, attached between SPIRIT FATHER's shoulder blades and running down to FATHER's chest.
<<<image_4>>> SCYTHE: dark wooden haft, curved steel blade. Carried by REAPER only.
<<<image_5>>> and <<<image_6>>> ROOM: bedroom geography, materials, curtains, window, bed, walls. Use for space and materials only, not for framing.
<<<image_7>>> FATHER: 1.90 m adult man asleep on his back, dark hair, dark short-sleeve top, light jeans. Face, hair and build 100% match the reference.
<<<image_8>>> Continuity anchor for the first visible frame: positions, lighting and cord shape start exactly from this state.

LOCATION MAP
Bedroom at night. The bed sits in the lower third of the world, its long axis running screen-left to screen-right: FATHER's head screen-left on the pillow, feet screen-right. FATHER lies flat on his back on top of the covers.
The camera stays on the near long side of the bed for the entire sequence. REAPER stands on the far long side of the bed, on the floor, her feet planted, her chest and head above the mattress line.
Behind REAPER: the window with cold blue night light and pale curtains. Screen-left: a bedside lamp casting warm light low across FATHER's head and shoulders.
SPIRIT FATHER floats horizontally 1.2 meters above FATHER, same orientation, head screen-left, feet screen-right, face turned up to the ceiling.
The SILVER CORD runs as one taut diagonal line from between SPIRIT FATHER's shoulder blades down to FATHER's chest, passing low across the space directly in front of REAPER, at her chest height.
The 180-degree line is the bed's long axis. The camera never crosses it.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains REAPER, the SCYTHE, the SILVER CORD and part of FATHER's sleeping body. No empty establishing frame. No delayed character reveal. The spatial relationship is readable immediately in frame one.
REAPER's torso faces the SILVER CORD. Her eyes stay locked on the SILVER CORD at chest height in front of her. Her head never tilts up. She never looks at SPIRIT FATHER above her, at any point, in any shot.
Both of REAPER's bone hands grip the scythe haft, right hand high, left hand low.
FATHER stays flat on his back, eyes closed, unmoving, breathing slowly, for the whole sequence.
Exactly one REAPER in frame at all times. No duplicate, no reflection double, no second hooded figure.


OPTICS
SHOT A LENS LOCK = 29 degree diagonal field of view, short telephoto portrait lens character, camera 4 to 5 meters from REAPER. Close framing achieved through lens reach, not physical proximity. REAPER is razor-sharp, the window and curtains behind her compress and dissolve into soft blue bokeh, only she and the blade are sharp.
SHOT B LENS LOCK = 47 degree diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character, camera 3 meters from the action, natural human-eye perspective, zero obvious distortion, comfortable depth of field, the room readable but not exaggerated.
SHOT C LENS LOCK = 47 degree diagonal field of view, standard normal lens character, camera 2.5 to 3 meters from REAPER. Same lens character as Shot B, only the camera position changes.


CAMERA
Shot A: camera on the near side of the bed at REAPER's chest height, slightly low angle looking up at her, REAPER framed chest-up occupying the centre and screen-right third, the SILVER CORD entering frame across her chest. Camera locked, only a faint handheld shoulder-mounted weight, operator breath, micro-settling, no digital jitter.
Shot B: camera drops to just above mattress level on the near side, looking along FATHER's sleeping body toward REAPER, the blade travelling across the upper half of frame. Camera locked.
Shot C: camera at REAPER's face height on the near side, framing her head, the blade and the cord contact point together. Camera holds, absorbing one small physical bump on the deflection, then settles.


ACTION TIMING
0:00 to 0:02, SHOT A. REAPER stands on the far side of the bed, both hands on the haft, eyes locked forward on the SILVER CORD. She raises the SCYTHE high above her right shoulder, blade angled up and camera-right, arms carrying the visible weight of steel and wood, a slow controlled wind-up with a small settle at the top. Her hood shifts a fraction behind the motion. She does not look up.
HARD CUT at 0:02.
0:02 to 0:03.5, SHOT B. REAPER swings the SCYTHE across the frame from screen-right to screen-left in one committed accelerating arc, the blade travelling low above FATHER's sleeping body toward the SILVER CORD. The haft bends slightly under load, her shoulders and hips rotate into the swing, her robe drags a beat behind her body.
HARD CUT at 0:03.5.
0:03.5 to 0:05, SHOT C. The blade meets the SILVER CORD and sinks into it. The cord bows deeply away from the blade like the string of a drawn bow, stretching into a smooth deep curve, and holds firm as one continuous unbroken strand. It snaps straight and deflects the blade back to screen-right along the same straight line the swing came in on. The SCYTHE is torn out of both of REAPER's hands and whips back past her head toward screen-right, one hand's width from her face, and exits the right edge of frame. A beat too late, REAPER drops into a clumsy panicked crouch, both bone arms clamped flat over her hood, shoulders hunched, an instinctive graceless flinch and never a skilled dodge.

PHYSICS
The SCYTHE has real mass: wooden haft, heavy steel blade, visible inertia, acceleration and deceleration, no weightless swing, no teleporting between poses. It stays in continuous contact with REAPER's hands until the deflection tears it loose.
The SILVER CORD behaves as a taut elastic strand under load: it bows into a smooth deep curve, stores tension, then releases it in one snap. It is never cut, never frayed, never severed, never split. No sparks, no explosion, no magic burst.
REAPER's crouch has real ground contact and weight transfer: knees fold, feet plant, robe collapses and settles a beat after her body, hood fabric lags behind her head.
SPIRIT FATHER's retraction is fast but physical: the translucent body accelerates downward along the cord, compresses into FATHER's chest, and the glow dissipates.
FATHER's body has weight on the mattress, chest rising and falling slowly, head sunk into the pillow. The bed does not move.
Cloth delay on the robe and the hood. No floating motion, no rubbery CG motion, no game-engine physics.

LIGHTING
Primary source: warm bedside lamp low on screen-left, throwing warm light across FATHER's face, shoulders and chest.
Secondary source: cold blue night light through the window directly behind REAPER, separating her hood and shoulders with a cool rim and keeping the inside of her hood dark.
Third source: SPIRIT FATHER's own warm glow from above, spilling a soft warm pool down onto the bed and onto the top of REAPER's hood and the scythe blade.
REAPER's red eyes stay self-luminous inside the shadow of the hood.
Deep blue shadows fill the room corners and the ceiling. The overall image stays low-key and night-lit. No flat front key light, no beauty fill, no studio light, no daylight.

AUDIO
Environmental and action sound only.
Swing: a low weighted whoosh of steel through air.
Impact: a deep taut resonant thrum as the cord loads and releases, then a hard metallic whip as the blade is thrown.
Off screen to the right: one heavy metallic crash against a wall, then steel clattering onto a hard floor.
Retraction: a short suction whoosh as SPIRIT FATHER is pulled down into the body.
Then complete silence, holding, with only faint room tone and FATHER's slow breathing.
No music, no score, no BGM, no instruments. No dialogue. No subtitles. No heart monitor beeps. No medical equipment sounds.

STYLE
Pixar-style 3D animated feature film, stylised character shapes with physically grounded lighting, rich subsurface skin, soft volumetric night atmosphere, cinematic depth. Deakins controlled low-key night interior.

POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
Exactly one REAPER in frame; no duplicate characters with identical appearance or clothing.
REAPER stays exactly 1.50 m tall in every shot; her head never rises above the level of SPIRIT FATHER's floating body.
REAPER never looks up at SPIRIT FATHER, in any shot, however absurd the situation becomes.
The strike travels screen-right to screen-left; the deflection travels screen-left to screen-right along the same straight line. Screen direction never reverses.
The whole failure happens within a hand's width of REAPER's face and is the only failure she actually witnesses.
From the moment the SCYTHE leaves her hands it is gone: it does not re-enter frame, she does not look for it, she never picks it up again.
The SILVER CORD stays intact and continuous through every frame.
Faces stable and undistorted, correct limb anatomy, no clipping, no extra limbs.
Sharp clarity, stable picture, no blur, no ghosting, no flickering. No logo, no watermark, no on-screen text.
